title: embeddings-rerank-incident-scratch-zoe-li-2026-03-21
content:
Context:
- Working notes for recent anomalies observed in embeddings->rerank endpoint (prod vs staging).
- Two main symptoms observed 2026-03-19 -> 2026-03-20: intermittent dimension mismatch errors when calling the rerank endpoint and latency spikes for batched reranking requests.

Hypothesis summary (early):
- Dimension mismatch errors originate from a downstream model change or an upstream embedding pipeline change (new tokenizer or new embedding model variant).
- Latency spikes correlate with larger batch sizes and a small percentage of requests that hit a cold KV cache or a slow backend host (possible N+1 where some replicas are on lower-perf nodes).

Repro steps attempted so far:
1) Replayed user request that produced error using local staging data and prod model config:
   - curl + example payload:
     curl -X POST "https://rerank.prod.redwood/v1/rerank" -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query_embedding": [0.01, 0.2, ...], "candidate_embeddings": [[0.02, 0.1, ...], ...] }'
   - Result: success on staging (no dim error).

2) Variation: send candidate batch where one candidate has shorter vector length (simulate corrupt pipeline):
   - Observed: service returned 400 with body:
     {"error":"embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536, got 128", "code":"DIM_MISMATCH"}
   - Confirms validation path works and returns clear error.

3) Pulled recent deployment diffs (last 7 days) from rerank-service repo:
   - PRs: #408 changed embedding preprocessing; #412 changed batching logic (see linked PR).
   - Local checkout of #408 reproduces mismatch when running preprocessing binary with older serialized embeddings.

4) Load-testing to reproduce latency spikes:
   - k6 script hitting /v1/rerank with 50 concurrent users, payloads of 64 candidates each.
   - Observed p95 latency jump from ~120ms -> ~800ms at ~35 rps sustained.
   - CPU on rerank workers pinned at ~85% when spike happens; tail latencies dominated by a few hosts showing GC/paging events.

Logs / error snippets:
- 2026-03-19T15:22:05Z ERROR rerank-handler request_id=abcd1234 "embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536, got 128"
- 2026-03-19T15:22:05Z DEBUG upstream-transformer worker=worker-17 loaded_model_variant=v2-quant
- 2026-03-19T15:23:43Z WARN rerank-batcher batch_id=0x7f9e slow_enqueue latency_ms=672 host=rerank-3
- 2026-03-20T02:12:11Z ERROR kv-cache host=kv-5 rpc_timeout=120s

Notes from telemetry / metrics:
- Embedding dimension distribution (last 24h): 99.7% = 1536 dims, 0.3% = 128 dims.
- Origins of 128-dim vectors: mostly traffic from a single client (client_id=acme-inc) and some internal integration tests.
- Latency correlation: high-p95 rerank spikes when batch sizes >= 32 and when > 5% of candidates are missing cached features (cache-miss rate).

Immediate theories to triage in priority order:
A) Pipeline regression: a recent change in embedding upstream swapped in a 128-dim model for certain traffic tags (A/B experiment). Need to validate feature flags and client routing.
B) Bad ingestion: some clients accidentally switched to a legacy embedding SDK producing 128-d vectors (client-side bug).
C) Inconsistent model variants in rerank cluster: some replicas expecting 1536 dims, others for 128 (rolling deploy mismatch).
D) Cache / host perf causing latency: cold cache + slow hosts cause tail latencies, exacerbated by larger batches (head-of-line blocking).

Immediate next actions (todo):
- [ ] Add stricter validation/logging on ingest path to log embedding source (model_name/model_version) for any vectors != 1536. (assigned: Maya)
- [ ] Run a query to list recent clients sending 128-d vectors and contact top 3. (assigned: Zoe)
- [ ] Roll back PR #408 on staging and re-run replay to confirm fix. (assigned: Aran)
- [ ] Add canary gating in deployment pipeline to prevent mixed-dimension rollouts. (assigned: eng-release)

Commands / queries used during investigation:
- BigQuery to find dimension distribution:
  SELECT client_id, model_name, ARRAY_LENGTH(embedding) AS dim, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM `prod_embeddings.events`
  WHERE _PARTITIONTIME BETWEEN TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
  GROUP BY client_id, model_name, dim
  ORDER BY cnt DESC

- Kubernetes pod logs quick check:
  kubectl -n prod logs deployment/rerank-service -l app=rerank -c rerank-worker --tail=500 | rg "dimension mismatch" -n

- Replayer snippet (python):
  payload = {"query_embedding": q_vec, "candidate_embeddings": cand_vecs}
  r = requests.post(RERANK_URL, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=10)

Open questions / unknowns:
- Why did a small fraction of traffic start sending 128-d embeddings? Is this explicitly flagged in client integrations or is auto-backfill happening?
- Are there any automated conversions in the ingestion pipeline that downsample embeddings for certain clients? (I looked and didn't find any obvious ones but might have missed the legacy adaptor.)
- Is there a time correlation between PR #408 merge and the first observed 128-dim events? Initial timeline suggests yes but need precise timestamps.

Potential mitigation (short-term):
- Reject any request with dimension != 1536 at the API edge with a clear error and rate-limit repeated offenders. That will stop downstream exceptions and reduce retried load.
- Add a temporary config flag to the rerank-service to fail-fast on mismatched dims and emit detailed context (model_name, client_id) to a dedicated SLO channel.

Longer term / follow-up:
- Add embedding schema enforcement in ingestion layer with automatic remediation pipeline (notify client, block, or auto-upgrade mapping).
- Implement dynamic batching that can multi-tenant across different dims by sharding requests to appropriate workers instead of submitting mixed-dim batches.
- Improve canary/deployment checks so rolling deploys that change embedding dims require stricter gating and integration tests.

Misc notes:
- Related incidents: see previous notes by Maya Patel (embeddings-rerank-debug-breadcrumbs-2026-03-04).
- Communication plan: if we identify a customer SDK bug, coordinate with CS to notify and provide hotfix instructions.

Quick timeline/log of actions taken:
- 2026-03-19 16:00 Zoe: noticed first DIM_MISMATCH alert in Sentry
- 2026-03-19 16:30 Aran: ran BigQuery to confirm distribution
- 2026-03-19 17:10 Maya: traced candidate ingestion logs to client id acme-inc
- 2026-03-20 09:00 Zoe: started k6 load tests to reproduce latency spikes
- 2026-03-20 12:00 Aran: opened PR #412 to add stronger validation in preprocessing

This doc is a scratchpad — will iterate and move to a tidy postmortem once root cause confirmed.

Contact: zli@redwood.ai / Slack: @zoe (DM for rapid updates)
summary: Scratchpad for embeddings->rerank incidents: dimension mismatch (1536 vs 128) and latency spikes on batched rerank. Includes replay commands, logs, metrics, hypotheses, and action items.
